N-027.correction: Owner decision 10. A manager (the roles that may issue a credit) ends a shipment that has a problem on record as LOST, naming the kind (lost, destroyed, refused for good) and what happened. In the same save every quantity not yet credited on its invoice, its tax and its freight are credited. Stock is not moved a second time: it left the books at dispatch, and the cost stays on the order as a sale with no revenue. Nothing is automatic, and it cannot be undone. Material that comes back is a return, as before.
